text:
Maria: AM pulse — quick updates
- Yesterday: synced with UX & merged spec v2 for the batch endpoint (PR #3421)
- Blocker: QA env-3 missing DB seed for new catalog — integration tests blocked
- Today: finish review on Devin's quantization doc, then unblock QA once seed script lands

Devin: pushed seed script to the infra branch, needs SRE approval @Ashok
- PR: #3430
- Quick question: can we lower canary qps from 200 -> 100 for the next rollout? :thinking_face:

Ashok: I can review the seed script at 11:30 PT. If it's idempotent we're good. For canary qps I prefer starting at 50 to be safe
- Also saw intermittent redis auth errors in staging last night — filing a ticket now

Sarah: QA update: we'll run smoke once seed is present. ETA ~15:00 PT. Need 2-3 representative test vectors from product to validate output changes

Kevin: CR ping: reviewed PR #3428 (routing policy changes) — left inline about fallback ordering, needs one more dev ack

Maria: @Kevin saw your comment, agree on changing fallback order. If we can't land it today can we decouple the config change into a follow-up?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for release/2026-03-17 started at 2030123500, progress: 30% nodes updated, 2/10 failures in sg-west-1 — auto-abort threshold not hit

Devin: noted @deploy-bot. If sg-west-1 keeps failing, please route traffic to sg-east for the canary until infra stabilizes

Ashok: Filing incident INC-5587 for sg-west-1 (redis auth flaps). Assigning to eng-infra, will update channel when triage complete

Sarah: small ask for product: can you attach expected SLO numbers per route in the spec doc? QA uses those to decide pass/fail (latency + error rate)

Maria: will add an SLO table to spec v2 by noon and drop 2 representative prompts/examples in the doc

Kevin: I'll try to merge PR #3428 before EOD, will ping if blocked

Maria: great — if anything blocks a merge or QA run, ping #product-review or @oncall. Otherwise, rolling into the afternoon: focus on launch checklist items and canary monitoring dashboards :rocket:
